areas_raw: Professor White is an expert in youth development, particularly in how socio-emotional and socio-cognitive development unfolds across time and in the context of exposures to both proximal (e.g., family, community) and more distal (e.g., national policy) factors. Her work also supports methodological advances, helping to define the characteristics and features of higher-quality scientific inquiry, especially with populations who have been underserved by the psychological and developmental sciences. With over 80 publications and national and international recognition for her contributions to advancing the science of child development, her scholarship documents the contextual challenges and opportunities today's U.S. youth face and how such factors combine to promote or inhibit their adjustment and mental health.
